nodes.label: Phosmith Favicon
nodes.description: 32x32 Next.js App Router file-convention icon: dark #0B0D12 rounded square (rx 7) carrying one cyan #06B8D4 four-point sparkle. Two elements total — no gradients, no filters, no clip.
nodes.rationale: Same dark-rounded-badge silhouette as logo.svg but the entire stream/node/glow system is discarded: at 16-32 CSS px hairline 1.2px strokes and stdDeviation-16 blurs turn to mud, so the identity is carried by silhouette + the single cyan token instead.

nodes.label: Four-Point Sparkle Glyph
nodes.rationale: One closed path of four concave quadratic-feel cubic arcs from (16,3)/(29,16)/(16,29)/(3,16) — a four-point star with pinched waists, the conventional 'AI / enhance' sparkle. Solid fill instead of a blur stack: it reads as emitted light at tiny sizes where an actual glow filter cannot.
